title: Montserrat, lunch and vineyard
text: This was a great trip. Alex our guide was so knowledgable. He took time to explain everything, was really helpful and easy going. The lunch was excellent. We ate in a lovey local restaurant in the countryside full of locals so it felt very authentic. The vineyard was really interesting and the owner took her time to explain the Cava making process and then we had plenty of time to try different Cavas. Overall this was a brilliant day and I’d highly recommend it.
author: 916larag

title: Super enjoyable trip
text: We had a really great day with Alex on this tour. Montserrat was spectacular and the winery visit with Lidia from Romagosa winery was fantastic. A really great day out for anyone visited by Sitges or Barcelona.
author: V2390DSdavidg

title: Montserrat is a must see!
text: Alex was a great guide. We first visited  Montserrat. We recommend taking your own ear buds. There is an audio app that tells you a lot about the Basilica. The wine tasting was at Romagosa. It is a nine generation  winery. We learned about the making of cava from one of the owners. Spectacular.
author: Mary M

title: Fun day of sight seeing.
text: Loved the convenience of being picked up and dropped from our location in Sitges. Alex and his colleague were very prompt and attentive to our group's need to be back at an earlier time. They were friendly and efficient at getting us to Monserrat and allowing us to explore at our own pace and level of interest. We were a group of 9 so there were many different levels of interest. The lunch was fun as was the winery. The only word of caution is that the ride involves lots of winding roads so if you are one to get car sick, make sure you take appropriate precautions so that you can enjoy the day
author: Explorer785530
